description: Login, Register, Refresh, Logout, Validate, and session management are proto-owned Connect RPCs with full Go CLI parity; the only REST endpoints are the non-RPC web standards (JWKS, callbacks).

requirements.description: Login, Register, Refresh, Logout, Validate, and all session management operations must be defined as Connect RPCs with protobuf schemas as the source of truth. A Go CLI must expose all the same operations as the Connect surface with identical semantics. The only non-RPC HTTP endpoints are web-standard ones: JWKS at /.well-known/jwks.json and OAuth callback URLs. REST shims for RPC operations are explicitly not provided.
requirements.title: Connect-RPC Surface with Full Go CLI Parity

validation.notes: api/internal/proto/proto_test.go: protobuf schema compiles cleanly; all required RPC methods (Login, Register, Refresh, Logout, Validate, ListSessions, RevokeSession) are present in the service definition
api/internal/cli/cli_test.go: CLI command definitions map 1:1 to RPC methods; no CLI command lacks a corresponding RPC
api/handlers/auth/connect_e2e_test.go: call Login RPC via Connect HTTP/2 client → receives LoginResponse with access and refresh tokens
api/handlers/auth/connect_e2e_test.go: call Register RPC → account created; call Validate RPC with issued token → valid response with claims
api/handlers/session/connect_session_e2e_test.go: call ListSessions and RevokeSession RPCs via Connect client → correct behavior matching REST-equivalent semantics
api/handlers/auth/connect_e2e_test.go: attempt to call an RPC operation via a plain REST path (not JWKS/callback) → 404 or method-not-allowed

title: Connect-RPC Surface + CLI Parity
